evidence.reason: `run_command` starts the child in a new session/process group, and `_kill_process_group` explicitly exists to ensure descendants of that group are confirmed exited because they can still write to the guarded tree. The only calls are on `TimeoutExpired` and `BaseException` during `communicate`; after normal `communicate()` completion, a nonzero direct-child exit reaches line 136 and raises without finalizing the process group. A background descendant with redirected streams can therefore survive and race a retry in the same checkout.
